The cheapest five-star book in the Mystery category is **The Girl You Lost**, priced at **£12.29**.

The category has two pages, and I checked both. It has six five-star books:

| Title | Price |
|---|---|
| The Girl You Lost | £12.29 |
| The Silkworm (Cormoran Strike #2) | £23.05 |
| What Happened on Beale Street (Secrets of the South Mysteries #2) | £25.37 |
| A Time of Torment (Charlie Parker #14) | £48.35 |
| The Bachelor Girl's Guide to Murder (Herringford and Watts Mysteries #1) | £52.30 |

That is five books, not six. I miscounted when I first wrote the number.

The browser is still open on page 2 of the category, and I didn't close the tab.

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); echo $S; agent-browser --session $S open https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/category/books/mystery_3/index.html; agent-browser --session $S eval 'Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("article.product_pod")).map(a=>a.querySelector("p.star-rating").className+"|"+a.querySelector("h3 a").title+"|"+a.querySelector(".price_color").innerText+"|"+(document.querySelector(".current")||{}).innerText)'

agent-browser --session task-86d299aef091 open https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/category/books/mystery_3/index.html; cat <<'EOF' | agent-browser --session task-86d299aef091 eval --stdin
Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("article.product_pod")).map(a=>a.querySelector("p.star-rating").className+"|"+a.querySelector("h3 a").title+"|"+a.querySelector(".price_color").innerText).join("\n")+"\n"+(document.querySelector(".current")||{}).innerText
EOF
